name: Laserade: Sugar Rush
description:
About This Game

Dodge Deadly Lasers in First Person

Minimalist sci-fi levels are packed with laser drones that guard soda cans. Learn their patterns and watch your footing to avoid getting impaled by heated spikes. Try different routes and strategies while honing your reflexes.

Collect Items to Power Up and Unlock the Exit

Progress through each level by collecting the required amount of Suga energy drinks. They give you speed boosts which each can, allowing you to zip past lasers with more ease and reach previously inaccessible areas.

Manipulate the Environment to Your Advantage

Press floor buttons to remotely control other laser drones or activate objects, align laser crates with drones to knock them out, or push laser sheds into position for protection from them. 

Survive for a Chance to Win a Sweet Payout

Your sugar addiction leads you to signing up for Laserade - Suga Corp's annual contest for promoting their energy drink brand in which many perish for a chance to win $1M and unlimited Suga.
short_desc: Evade lasers and other hazards in this first-person action platformer while chugging as many Suga soft energy drinks as you can, boosting your speed while feeding your insatiable sugar addiction.
